_comment: Package front (QA Nov 14): the street in front of the auction house and its lobby. Same shape as props.json; generate.py adds STYLE to every prompt. Run with RODIN_PROPS_FILE=tools/rodin/props_front.json.

props.front_desk: a 1940s art deco hotel reception desk, curved front of polished walnut with brass bands, cream marble top, a wooden counter seen whole
props.front_postercase: a 1940s cinema poster display case on two short legs, a tall brass frame with a glass front around a blank movie poster, a small brass lamp hood on top
